svg.title: Feedforward from a measured extraction
svg.desc: At the first update after a 30 kilowatt extraction starts, PI alone keeps 75 percent, the heater with feedforward requests 90 percent and the one with a 36 kilowatt estimate 93 percent. With feedforward the water dips only 0.544 degrees Celsius during the heater's 1 second delivery delay; PI alone lets it fall to 33.75 degrees. The integral trims the wrong estimate's feedback part to 72 percent.
svg.text: Feedforward from a measured 30 kW extraction
Control Studio recording of this project · three heaters, same extraction · numbers answer the predictions
PI alone: down to 33.75 °C at 4.5 s
36 kW estimate: the integral trims the
feedback part to 72 %; the command ends at 90 %
